Today I lost my best friend my grandma my lichita my everything. 
❤️ Oh… the things I would trade to have you in my arms again, to kiss you to hug you to spoil you like you deserved. 
❤️ All I know is that I am who I am because of you, so in a way you will live forever in me. I am so grateful for all the time we had together but it still wasn’t enough. It would have never been enough for me. 
❤️ You made it to 96 and lived a beautiful life. 
❤️My grandma was loved by everyone who met her, she always made it a point to get to know everyone from the waiters to the cashiers. She was loving and caring and I will continue to carry her legacy by honoring who she was. 
❤️ I can say with a full heart that I have no regrets, not a single one when it comes to you. I told you how much I loved you when you were alive and I gave you everything I could and more and spent time with you while you were still here. I wouldn’t do anything different. 
I love you to infinity and beyond. 
Mi amorcito corazón hoy te me fuiste pero vives siempre en mi ♥️
UNTIL WE MEET AGAIN LICHITA QUERIDA

Boiling water for mopping is an extreme measure that you should only be doing once in awhile when your floors are nasty and only if you have tile floors. laminate, wood, vinyl, or marble you cannot use boiling water to clean your floors. Not only will you be messing up your floors but your mop will be messed up. It is so unnecessary! Warm water is just fine.
